The designer should either specify that the hole is to be masked during plating or increase the pre-plate bore size to compensate for the coating thickness.","recommended_correction":"Add a note specifying masking of the ⌀16 H7 hole before plating, or adjust the pre-plate dimension to allow for the I.Z.B.P. coating thickness so the final plated size remains within H7 limits."}]}
